name: SoFi Credit Card
summary: SoFi Credit Card offers 2% unlimited cashback redeemable as crypto through SoFi Invest. No annual or foreign transaction fees. First US chartered bank to offer crypto rewards redemption.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required

faq.question: Does the SoFi Credit Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the SoFi Credit Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the SoFi Credit Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
